title: Coarse-Graining Optimal Transport for Rollout-Free Post-Training of Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.41269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow matching depends critically on the coupling used to pair source and target samples. Optimal transport (OT) couplings can reduce velocity conflict and straighten trajectories; but, in practice, challenges remain: the source comes from a continuous distribution, only a finite number of target samples data are accessible, and the neural network has finite capacity. For these reasons, making the coupling more OT-like may not consistently improve sampling quality, in particular in the low number-of-function-evaluation (NFE) regime. Motivated by this, we introduce ReCouple, a controllable framework that constructs coarse-grained OT couplings, to better understand rollout-free OT-based post-training. translated_title: 面向流匹配无需滚动后训练的粗粒度最优传输方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41269v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：流匹配在很大程度上依赖于用于配对源样本与目标样本的耦合方式。最优传输（OT）耦合可以减少速度冲突并拉直轨迹；但在实践中仍存在挑战：源数据来自连续分布，可获取的目标样本数据数量有限，且神经网络的容量有限。出于这些原因，让耦合更接近最优传输并不一定能持续改善采样质量，尤其是在低函数评估次数（NFE）的场景下。受此启发，我们提出了 ReCouple，一个可控的框架，通过构建粗粒度的最优传输耦合，以更好地理解基于最优传输的无需滚动后训练。我们还考虑了该基本框架的扩展：ReCouple+ 通过提高源分辨率将该框架扩展到连续源设置，并在适当的极限下收敛到半离散最优传输；ReCouple++ 则进一步增加了空间重（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 ReCouple 可控框架，通过构造粗粒度最优传输耦合来实现流匹配的无需滚动后训练，并扩展出面向连续源设置的 ReCouple+ 与 ReCouple++，从而在低函数评估次数下改善采样质量。
en_tdlr: We introduce ReCouple, a controllable framework that constructs coarse-grained optimal transport couplings for rollout-free post-training of flow matching, with extensions ReCouple+ and ReCouple++ toward continuous-source settings to improve sampling quality in the low-NFE regime.
